title: Learning the Effect of Persuasion via Difference-In-Differences
abstract: arXiv:2410.14871v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a difference-in-differences framework to measure the persuasive impact of informational treatments on behavior in staggered treatment settings. We introduce two causal parameters, the forward and backward average persuasion rates on the treated, which refine the average treatment effect on the treated. The forward rate excludes cases of "preaching to the converted," while the backward rate omits "talking to a brick wall" cases. The backward rate coincides with the probability of necessity from the literature on probabilities of causation. We identify both persuasion rates under a no-backlash condition and a parallel-trends assumption imposed on a known transformation of response probabilities, taking the identity link as the baseline and nonlinear links as sensitivity checks. translated_title: 基于双重差分法学习说服效应
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个双重差分框架，用于在交错处理情境中衡量信息干预对行为的说服性影响。我们引入了两个因果参数——处理组的前向平均说服率和后向平均说服率，它们是对处理组平均处理效应的细化。前向率排除了“对已皈依者传教”的情形，而后向率则排除了“对牛弹琴”的情形。后向率与因果概率文献中的必要性概率相一致。我们在无反弹条件以及施加于响应概率某一已知变换上的平行趋势假设下，识别了这两种说服率，其中以恒等连接函数作为基准，非线性连接函数则作为敏感性检验。我们利用广义矩估计（GMM）和有限信息方法开发了估计与推断方法。我们通过一个应用展示了该框架的有用性。
tldr: 本文提出一个双重差分框架来识别交错处理情境下信息干预的说服效应，创新性地引入前向与后向平均说服率两个新的因果参数，并在无反弹条件与平行趋势假设下给出识别、GMM估计与推断方法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a difference-in-differences framework for identifying persuasion effects in staggered treatment settings, introducing forward and backward average persuasion rates as refined causal parameters, identified under a no-backlash condition and parallel trends with GMM-based estimation and inference.
